allow_instructions: Workspace-local filesystem read/write under C:/workspace (or the opened MKM workspace root) only — not outside the repo.

Local Python via py or python invoking repo-relative paths only: scripts/*.py, tests/*, and py -m pytest / lint / typecheck for this repo. Prefer: py scripts/check_*, py scripts/run_* (local artifacts only), py scripts/build_* (local artifacts only). Do not allow unconstrained interpreter invocations without a repo path.

Repo-local PowerShell script files only via: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\\Invoke-Mkm*.ps1 / scripts\\Verify-*.ps1 / scripts\\Register-*Readiness*.ps1 / health-patrol scripts under scripts\\. Never allow unconstrained shell interpreters.
Local validation families: pytest, ruff/eslint/tsc/lint, and in-repo package build/test when cwd is the workspace (npm/pnpm/vitest scoped to project dirs). No deploy scripts.
Git read/inspect only by default: status, diff, log, rev-parse, show, ls-files. Do not auto-run git push, force-push, or remote rewrite.
Deterministic manseryeok lookups via athena-manseryeok MCP (already allowlisted).
Already allowlisted low-risk local MCP only: filesystem, sequential-thinking, athena-manseryeok (and project-0-workspace-* aliases). Multitask subagents inherit the same narrow allowances.
block_instructions: KEEP MANUAL: devops-mcp (SSH/VPS/remote shell), notebooklm (external auth profile), compression-server (Track A KPI adjacent), athena-core memory mutations / gateway side effects.
KEEP MANUAL: production deploy, VPS restart/sync, Cloudflare dashboard login or edge token apply, browser login / authenticated external actions.

KEEP MANUAL: GitHub push / Push-GitHub-Explicit / external mirror; Gmail and external messaging; SEND; TRADE / live trading / real-money; secrets/credentials/permission changes; database destructive migration.
KEEP MANUAL: network-changing ops, paid side effects, irreversible schema/architecture changes, destructive delete/rollback.
FORBIDDEN autorun: unconstrained shell interpreters (PowerShell/CMD/Python/bash without repo-scoped -File or scripts/ path). No broad shell wildcards that ignore repo path scoping.
